about: New on TikTok Pal dances. Add a trend by adding an entry: keys are poses, one every (beats / keys.length) beats. Pose fields (all optional): x,y (body units, y<0 = up), r (tilt deg), sx, sy (squash), k (lean/skew), aL/aR (arm angle deg: 0 down, 90 out to the side, 180 up, negative = across the body), m (idle|walk|hop|happy), f (1 face right, -1 face left), tx (short text pop), star (1 = gold sparkle). ease: smooth|snap|linear. id: 2-13 lowercase letters (shop item dn_<id>). r: c|r|l rarity.

dances.name: Count & Shrug
